rules.condition: is this bot's hp below a quarter of its max?
is a visible enemy bearbot within melee range?
rules.criteria_true: distance to nearest enemy bearbot < melee_range
rules.criteria_false: distance to nearest enemy bearbot >= melee_range

rules.condition: is a visible enemy inside attack range?
is Chord off cooldown AND is at least one enemy or minion visible?
is a visible enemy approaching or close?
rules.criteria_true: enemy is getting closer OR enemy is at medium range but threatening

rules.condition: is there no immediate threat and no cooldowns ready?
rules.criteria_true: no enemies in danger zone AND all abilities on cooldown
rules.criteria_false: abilities available OR enemies in danger zone
